items.description: This summer has seen hot weather records broken, drought and major damage from fires.

items.title: Croatia: 'Monster' fire triggers evacuation on Brac island
items.description: A rapidly spreading wildfire threatened homes and tourist accommodations on the Croatian island of Brac, with firefighters battling the blaze overnight.

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
items.description: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

items.title: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
items.description: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

items.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
items.description: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Canada seeks 'unique alliance' with EU, Carney says
items.description: Mark Carney clarified Canada's EU ambitions amid a WSJ report that Ottawa was exploring an "associate membership" with the bloc.

items.title: Cuban dance teacher ordered EU sabotage attacks from Russia
items.description: In 2024, a Cuban man coordinated a series of arson attacks in four EU countries while operating on behalf of Russian intelligence services. DW Investigations tracked him back to a Latin dance studio in Russia.

items.title: Germany: Merz's CDU comes out on top in Lower Saxony polls
items.description: The Christian Democrats have emerged as the strongest party at local elections in the state of Lower Saxony. The vote was closely watched as an indicator of the strength of the far-right AfD, which came in third.
